desc: Purpose-driven and designed so you can bring all your deer hunting essentials with you, from scent and calls, to binoculars and more. Features Mossy Oak Break-Up Country camo, the case fits scoped rifles or shotguns up to 48 and features three large pockets designed for what you bring to the hunt. The main front pocket has two rows of organization straps for all your gear. The rear pocket has an adjustable flap closure so you can fit even large accessories in this pocket. The center pouch has a large opening and a drawstring closure to easily fit your scent/cover spray. The inside of the case has heavy-duty dual-density foam for ultimate protection. The lining is easy clean, and the oversized zippers make it easy to open and close. Lockable.
